en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic cliff scene: a person stands and poses on the very edge of a protruding rock ledge high above a deep valley of rugged granite cliffs and distant mountains. The perspective emphasizes the steep drop below the ledge. At the bottom in red text it identifies the location as Overhanging Rock at Glacier Point in Yosemite Valley, California. There are also large printed catalog numbers in the middle of the card.
